description: Culture-aware calendar intensity grid for visualizing daily decimal values. It supports full-year or inclusive custom ranges, configurable level counts and color schemes, localized month/day labels and legend text, accessible value tooltips, custom value formatting, and day selection callbacks without JavaScript interop.

parameters.name: CellSize
parameters.description: Size of each day cell in pixels. Defaults to 12.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the root element.

parameters.name: ColorScheme
parameters.description: Color scheme used for intensity levels. Defaults to Primary.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Culture used for week alignment and date formatting. Defaults to CurrentUICulture.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Inclusive start of a custom date range. Defaults to the start of the current year.

parameters.name: Levels
parameters.description: Number of intensity levels, including the empty level. Values below 2 are treated as 2. Defaults to 5.

parameters.name: MaxValue
parameters.description: Optional upper bound of the intensity scale. When omitted, the maximum positive value inside the rendered date range is used.

parameters.name: OnDayClick
parameters.description: Raised when a day cell is selected.

parameters.name: ShowDayLabels
parameters.description: Shows localized labels for the first, third, and fifth weekday rows. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: ShowLegend
parameters.description: Shows the localized intensity legend below the grid. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: ShowMonthLabels
parameters.description: Shows localized month labels above the grid. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Inclusive end of a custom date range. Defaults to the end of the current year.

parameters.name: ValueFormatter
parameters.description: Optional formatter for values displayed in day tooltips and accessible labels. The default formats values with two decimal places using Culture.

parameters.name: Values
parameters.description: Daily values displayed by the heatmap. Dates without an entry render as empty cells.

parameters.name: Year
parameters.description: Optional calendar year to render. When specified, the entire year is rendered and From and To are ignored.

examples.title: Annual expense heatmap
examples.description: Render one cell per day, format values as currency, and handle day selection.

examples.title: Custom three-month range
examples.description: Limit the grid to an inclusive date range and use the danger palette.
